text:
Michael Amadio has hired agent Andy Scott with extension talks ahead, the Ottawa Citizen reported this week, and he picked a good month to do it. Six goals in 20 games, four in his last ten, and our wins-added measure has him 57th of 522 skaters.

He's been modest about it. "Fortunate enough to be getting some chances recently and capitalising on them," read his line in TSN's headline, and that's an honest read. His chances are up (0.80 expected goals per 60, from 0.64 last season), but he's shooting 24%, well beyond our range for him. Coming Down the Pipe's Graeme Nichols posted that he "feels like he should have 10+ goals already." The underlying numbers say six is already generous.

What makes him valuable doesn't depend on the shooting. Evolving-Hockey had him 73rd of 401 forwards by wins above replacement last season, with opponents getting 0.16 fewer expected goals per 60 when he was out there (93rd percentile), though he also played beside strong teammates. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 57% of his shots coming off the rush.

His minutes are climbing, near 17 a night lately, all without power-play time.
